ValidationRule.description: Gitlab#467 : Upsell or Rate Change value can be used only when it is amendment opportunity
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(AND( OR( $Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c = 'Opportunity', $Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c = '' ), NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c) ), OR(ISNEW(),AND(ISCHANGED( SBQQ__Contracted__c ), SBQQ__Contracted__c)), OR(ISPICKVAL( Type , 'Up-Sell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Rate Change') ), ISBLANK( SBQQ__AmendedContract__c ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Upsell or Rate Change should only be used for amendment opportunities. Amended Contract is not populated.
